name: second-brain
description: Seconda mente: gestione completa della vita personale (task, agenda, finanze, obiettivi, note, alimentazione, allenamenti, social, notizie, assistente AI)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w mcp
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w client && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w mcp && npm run typecheck -w desktop
